The '''Nawataa Waterfall''' was a waterfall formed by the [[Chenataa river]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Hidden behind the waterfall lay the entrance to the [[Webweaver caverns]].
[[File:Webweaver_Caverns.jpg|thumb|The Nawataa Waterfall behind the caverns.]]

==Behind the scenes==
The Nawataa Waterfall first appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''
